claim_tested: ALPP active site predicts a restricted substrate
key_finding: Catalytic residues conserved; Glu429 and a hydrophobic pocket explain uncompetitive L-amino-acid inhibition; authors speculate a phosphoprotein substrate from the valley/crown shape
confidence: high for structure, low for the substrate speculation (no binding or kinetic data)

claim_tested: ALPP/ALPL active-site differences set substrate preference
key_finding: Reciprocal mutagenesis of all residues differing within 12 Å shows residue 108 sets L-homoarginine, His434 sets levamisole and theophylline sensitivity; inhibitor specificities swapped between isozymes; no substrate-class change reported
context: recombinant human TNAP and PLAP, COS-1 expression
confidence: high; inhibitor panel only, substrate panel limited to pNPP

claim_tested: The ALPP-unique active-site residue selects substrate
key_finding: PLAP and GCAP differ by 7 residues; position 429 alone sets L-leucine, EDTA and heat sensitivity; Glu429 stabilises metal binding via His320
context: GCAP/PLAP mutants and chimeras in COS-1 cells

claim_tested: ALPP has a substrate class distinct from ALPL
key_finding: Placental ALP in maternal third-trimester blood corrects hypophosphatasemia and lowers PEA, PPi and PLP, with rebound after childbirth
context: 3 human hypophosphatasia carriers, pregnancy time course
confidence: moderate; n=3, association in vivo rather than purified kinetics

claim_tested: The crown (surface loop) domain carries isozyme-specific properties
key_finding: Swapping the TNAP loop into PLAP transfers heat lability and half of collagen binding, changes inhibitor side-chain stabilisation, and does not change the catalytic chemistry
confidence: high; mouse-human chimeras, collagen binding measured as affinity not catalysis

claim_tested: ALPP active site differs enough from ALPL to narrow substrate class
key_finding: 23/26 residues within 6 Å identical (88% vs 55% background, Fisher p=7.1e-4); 66 active-site Cα superpose at 0.31 Å RMSD; Zn2 0.17 Å, Zn1 0.34 Å apart
confidence: high; static structures, 7YIW at 2.89 Å, crown loops partly mobile

key_finding: Widest approach channel to the catalytic Ser: PLAP 3.28 Å, TNAP 4.00 Å, E. coli AP 3.38 Å; no direction exceeds 4 Å in PLAP
confidence: moderate; product-bound and static, ignores loop breathing

claim_tested: Specificity positions can be scored across primate ALPP orthologs
key_finding: No primate sequence separates ALPP from ALPG by >2% identity; 26/29 catalytic and specificity positions invariant; Gly93 is human/chimp-specific
confidence: moderate; gene-symbol orthology unreliable in this recent duplication cluster

claim_tested: There is an ALPP substrate annotation to narrow
key_finding: ALPP carries only GO:0004035, GO:0016791, metal binding ISS and two interactome-screen protein binding IPIs; no BP term; ALPL carries 10 substrate-level MF terms ALPP lacks
confidence: high; database snapshot of this run
